name: glass-lens
title: Glass Lens
description: Move the lens over the artwork
useCases: On a fabric product page, a shopper moves the lens over a photo to inspect the weave.
During a design review, a designer magnifies a screenshot detail and moves the lens with the arrow keys.
task: Move the lens over the artwork
behavior: Supply an image URL in image. The lens magnifies that same image and label names the control.
